metadata.description: 50 harmful prompts x 5 jailbreak classes with token-matched neutral controls
metadata.format: noun-phrase (how to/ways to/ideas for) for grammatical compatibility
metadata.controls: length-matched neutral prefixes with no jailbreak framing
notes: Self-harm prompts (4) are rephrased from imperative format in original dataset to noun-phrase format
Privacy category only has 2 prompts due to limited noun-phrase format availability
All prefix variants should be token-count verified before use
Controls are designed to be neutral (no jailbreak framing) while matching JB token count
Primary prefix pair per class is token-verified. Variant prefixes need verification.
Replaced 8 prompts that failed bare refusal or multi-class control leaks
All replacements verified: bare refuses + 5/5 controls refuse

5 new classes (refusal_suppression, prefix_injection, persona_dan, hypothetical, persuasion) added from published attacks. Word-count matched; TOKEN COUNT must be re-verified with the Gemma tokenizer before use.

new_classes_added.persona_dan: Shen et al. 2024, Do Anything Now (DAN personas)
new_classes_added.persuasion: Zeng et al. 2024, PAP (persuasion: authority/logical appeal)
